identity.name: Orient Star Semi-Skeleton
identity.one_liner: The higher-tier Orient Star with a semi-skeleton open heart — the gateway to Japanese manufacture watchmaking at the sub-$700 price point.

narrative.story: The Orient Star line sits above the standard Orient range in finish, movement decoration, and case execution. The Semi-Skeleton exposes part of the in-house F6N47 caliber through an open-heart window at 9 o'clock. The 40mm case, sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating, and 50-hour reserve put it in direct competition with entry Seiko Presage and Tissot. In the Asian market it is the watch a buyer chooses when they want mechanical watchmaking with visible decoration at the sub-$700 tier.
narrative.collector_notes: The F6N47 is a decorated version of the F6 series with a semi-skeleton bridge. Orient Star models are assembled in Japan, unlike the standard Orient range.
